item.title: Free normaliser-quotient action on chamber labels

article.statement: For ḡ∈N(W,J)=Norm_W(W_J)/W_J and any representative g, let y be the minimum-length element of gxW_I. Then ḡ·(x,I)=(y,I). Labels with the same second component form one orbit; the action is free and commutes with each defined adjacent crossing ω_{a,I}, preserving its index.
article.locator: Lemma 3.24(1)–(4), printed p. 12; underlying linear action in Lemma 3.23, printed p. 12.

portal.statement: The same free action, fibre-orbit description and crossing equivariance in the finite-rank relative chamber geometry, without requiring W or W_J finite.

translation.type:
∀ {S : Type*} [Finite S] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S),
  let W := CoxeterMatrix.Group M
  let cs := CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem M
  let Label := { p : W × Set S //
    Set.image (fun u : W => u * p.1) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J : Set W) =
      Set.image (fun u : W => p.1 * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs p.2 : Set W) ∧
    CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs p.2 p.1 }
  let Θ := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace J
  letI : TopologicalSpace Θ := TopologicalSpace.induced
    (fun f : Θ => ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f.val)
    (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real))
  let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) := (RelativeCone M J).2.2.2.2.2
  let face : Set S → Set (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S) := fun I =>
    { f | f ∈ ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace I ∧
      ∀ i : S, i ∉ I → 0 < ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f i }
  let region : Label → Set Θ := fun p =>
    { f | ∃ h : ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S,
      h ∈ face p.val.2 ∧ ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualAction M p.val.1 h = f.val }
  let affineDimension : Set Θ → Nat := fun C =>
    Module.finrank Real (AffineSubspace.direction (affineSpan Real C))
  let wall : Set Θ → Set Θ → Prop := fun C F =>
    Set.Nonempty F ∧ ∃ H : Submodule Real Θ, H ∈ arrangement ∧
      F = closure C ∩ (H : Set Θ) ∧ affineDimension F + 1 = affineDimension C
  let adjacent : Label → Label → Prop := fun p q =>
    region p ≠ region q ∧ ∃ F : Set Θ, wall (region p) F ∧ wall (region q) F
  let component : Set S → S → Set S := fun I a =>
    { b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }
  let Norm := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.CoxeterNormalizer M J
  let N := ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J
  let quotientMap : Norm → N := QuotientGroup.mk'
    ((ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf Norm)
  ∃ action : N →* Equiv.Perm Label,
    (∀ (g : Norm) (p : Label),
      let y := action (quotientMap g) p
      y.val.2 = p.val.2 ∧
      CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs p.val.2 y.val.1 ∧
      ∃ u : W, u ∈ CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs p.val.2 ∧
        y.val.1 = g.val * p.val.1 * u) ∧
    (∀ p q : Label, (∃ g : N, action g p = q) ↔ p.val.2 = q.val.2) ∧
    (∀ (g : N) (p : Label), action g p = p → g = 1) ∧
    (∀ (g : N) (p : Label),
      Set.image (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.quotientRepresentation M J g) (region p) =
        region (action g p)) ∧
    (∀ (g : N) (p q : Label), adjacent p q → adjacent (action g p) (action g q)) ∧
    (∀ (g : N) (p q : Label), adjacent p q →
      ∀ (a : S) (ha : a ∉ p.val.2)
        (hD : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component p.val.2 a))),
        (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs p.val.2 a ha hD).2.2 p.val.1 = q.val →
        (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs p.val.2 a ha hD).2.2 (action g p).val.1 =
          (action g q).val)

items.title: Tits cone intersection and relative arrangement

article.statement: For J ⊆ Γ₀, let Θ_J = {f ∈ V*: f(α_j)=0 for every j∈J}. Define Cone(J)=Cone∩Θ_J, taking its interior in Θ_J. Define Φ^J={α∈Φ: Θ_J is not contained in H_α}=Φ\Φ_J and H^J={H_α∩Θ_J: α∈Φ^J_+}, counting coincident traces once.
article.locator: §3.1, printed p. 7, equations (3.1)–(3.3); §1.1.2, printed p. 2.

portal.statement: The same relative cone, roots and distinct hyperplane traces, explicitly using finite Γ₀ and the induced coordinate Euclidean topology. Neither W nor W_J is required to be finite.
portal.locator: Definition and Source notes of def-relative-cone-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Local finiteness in the relative interior

article.statement: Every u∈Cone(J)° belongs to an open ball in Cone(J) meeting only finitely many members of H^J. Consequently (Cone(J)°,H^J) is locally finite.
article.locator: Proposition 3.6, printed p. 9; Remark 3.7 distinguishes this from ambient local finiteness.

portal.statement: For finite Γ₀ and arbitrary J, every point of the relative interior has a relative Euclidean ball contained in Cone(J) meeting finitely many distinct relative hyperplanes. No spherical-type hypothesis is imposed.

items.title: Minimal coset labels classify relative chambers

article.statement: The map (x,I)↦xC_I bijects the chambers of (Cone(J)°,H^J) with Cham(J)={(x,I): W_Jx=xW_I and x has minimum length in xW_I}. Here C_I={f∈Θ_I: f(α_i)>0 for i∉I}.
article.locator: Theorem 3.9 and equation (3.10), printed pp. 9–10; equation (3.2), printed p. 7.

portal.statement: The same chamber-labelling bijection under the finite-rank geometric convention, for arbitrary Coxeter type and arbitrary J. The algebraic label set itself is available at arbitrary rank.
portal.locator: Statement, Facts & Assumptions and Source notes of thm-chamber-labelling-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Elementary crossing elements from spherical components

article.statement: For a∉I, let D=[I,a] be the component containing a in the diagram induced on I∪{a}. When W_D is finite, define v_{a,I}=w_{D\{a}}w_D, K=(I∪{a})\{ι_D(a)}, and ω_{a,I}(x,I)=(xv_{a,I},K). The opposition permutation satisfies w_Dα_i=−α_{ι_D(i)}. Finiteness is required of W_D, not of W_I or W_{I∪{a}}.
article.locator: Notation 3.13 and equations (3.14)–(3.15), printed p. 10; Notation 2.5 and equation (2.6), printed p. 5.

portal.statement: The same component-based construction on algebraic labels. Its definition initially gives a pair in W×P(Γ₀); preservation of chamber labels and geometric adjacency require subsequent results.

items.title: Adjacent chambers and inverse elementary crossings

article.statement: For adjacent chambers (x,I),(y,K), the common wall has unique describing indices a∉I and a′∉K, with I∪{a}=K∪{a′}. Their crossing components coincide and are spherical. The crossings satisfy ω_{a,I}(x,I)=(y,K), ω_{a′,K}(y,K)=(x,I), and v_{a,I}v_{a′,K}=v_{a′,K}v_{a,I}=1.
article.locator: Proposition 3.17 and following sentence, printed p. 11.

portal.statement: In finite rank, the common closed wall is the closure of xC_{I∪{a}} and of yC_{K∪{a′}}. The describing indices, finite crossing components, prescribed opposite labels and inverse products have the stated properties. Neither W_I nor W_{I∪{a}} is assumed finite.

items.title: Finite crossing paths connect relative chambers

article.statement: Any two chambers are related by a finite sequence of simple wall crossings.
article.locator: Lemma 3.20(3) and Remark 3.22, printed p. 11; Remark 3.8, printed p. 9.

portal.statement: For a finite-rank Coxeter system and arbitrary J, any two relative chambers are joined by finitely many component-based simple crossings. The empty sequence is allowed for equal endpoints.

items.title: Free normaliser-quotient action on chamber labels

article.statement: For ḡ∈N(W,J)=Norm_W(W_J)/W_J and any representative g, let y be the minimum-length element of gxW_I. Then ḡ·(x,I)=(y,I). Labels with the same second component form one orbit; the action is free and commutes with each defined adjacent crossing ω_{a,I}, preserving its index.
article.locator: Lemma 3.24(1)–(4), printed p. 12; underlying linear action in Lemma 3.23, printed p. 12.

portal.statement: The same free action, fibre-orbit description and crossing equivariance in the finite-rank relative chamber geometry, without requiring W or W_J finite.

items.title: Geodesicity equals Coxeter-length additivity

article.statement: For a chamber path p with consecutive crossing elements v₁,…,v_m and product v_p, p is geodesic if and only if ℓ(v_p)=Σ_i ℓ(v_i). Geodesic means having the minimum number of crossings between its endpoints.
article.locator: Proposition 3.29, printed pp. 13–14; path and geodesic conventions in §3.4, printed p. 13.

portal.statement: The same equivalence for finite-rank relative chamber paths, including the one-chamber path with empty product and sum. Its suppliers include the length/half-space criterion and translation between relative arrangements.

items.title: Brink–Howlett groupoid with the article's composition convention

article.statement: Fix a Coxeter diagram Γ, its Coxeter group W and J⊆Γ₀. An associate I of J has W_I conjugate to W_J. The groupoid BH(J) has these associates as objects and Hom_BH(I,K)={x∈W: x{α_k:k∈K}={α_i:i∈I}}. If x:I→K and y:K→L, their left-to-right composite is xy:I→L.
article.locator: §4.1, definition preceding Remark 4.1, printed p. 15; associates in Definition 2.7, printed p. 5.

portal.statement: The same small connected groupoid, with arrows tagged by source and target and multiplication read left to right. No finite-rank or spherical-type restriction is imposed.

items.title: Elementary crossings are Brink–Howlett arrows

article.statement: If I is an associate of J, a∉I and W_[I,a] is finite, then v_{a,I}∈Hom_BH(I,(I∪{a})\{ι_[I,a](a)}).
article.locator: Lemma 4.2, printed p. 15.

portal.statement: At arbitrary rank, the prescribed target K is an associate of J and v_{a,I}{α_k:k∈K}={α_i:i∈I}. Only the crossing component is required to be spherical.

items.title: Singleton-arrow groupoid on chamber labels

article.statement: The groupoid BH̃(J) has objects Cham(J), with Hom((x,I),(y,K)) the singleton labelled x⁻¹y. Composition multiplies labels on the right. For adjacent chambers its arrow is labelled by their elementary crossing element.
article.locator: Definition 4.3 and following paragraph, printed p. 15.

portal.statement: The algebraic singleton-arrow construction applies at arbitrary rank, retaining endpoint tags. Its geometric chamber and adjacent-crossing interpretation additionally uses finite rank, without assuming W, W_I or W_{I∪{a}} finite.

items.title: Adjacent crossings generate the universal wall groupoid

article.statement: For any chamber labels (x,I),(y,K), there is a finite crossing path p between them whose product v_p equals x⁻¹y. Thus the adjacent-crossing arrows generate BH̃(J). The path need not be unique.
article.locator: Proposition 4.4, printed p. 16.

portal.statement: The same factorization through finite paths in the finite-rank relative-interior arrangement, with endpoint-tagged arrows and the zero-crossing case included.

items.title: Chamber labels and prescribed-source arrow lifting

article.statement: For associates I,K of J: (1) chamber labels (x,I),(y,K) satisfy x⁻¹y∈Hom_BH(I,K); (2) if w∈Hom_BH(I,K) and (x,I)∈Cham(J), then (xw,K)∈Cham(J), and w labels the arrow upstairs from (x,I) to (xw,K).
article.locator: Proposition 4.6(1)–(2), printed p. 16.

portal.statement: The same assertions are stated with finite-rank hypotheses and geometric chamber identification. The main covering entry separately supplies an arbitrary-rank algebraic correspondence using canonical simple systems.

items.title: Theorem 1.3 / 4.7: universal covering, wall crossings and deck quotient

article.statement: Let Γ be a Coxeter diagram with Coxeter group W and J⊆Γ₀. The functor F:BH̃(J)→BH(J), defined by F(x,I)=I and F(x⁻¹y)=x⁻¹y, is a universal groupoid covering with Deck(F)≅N(W,J). Preserve also Theorem 1.3's geometric content: its upstairs objects are the chambers of (Cone(J)°,H^J), its generating morphisms are simple crossings between adjacent chambers, and BH(J) is obtained as the N(W,J)-quotient of BH̃(J). No spherical-type restriction on W or W_J is stated.
article.locator: Theorem 1.3 and following paragraph, printed p. 2; Theorem 4.7, printed pp. 16–17; Definition 4.3, printed p. 15; Proposition 4.4, printed p. 16.

portal.statement: At arbitrary rank, the algebraic label groupoid covers BH(J) universally, has deck group N(W,J), and has quotient isomorphic to BH(J). Its geometric chamber identification, adjacent-generator interpretation and generation assertion explicitly use finite rank. Neither W nor W_J is required finite. This scope distinction remains explicit and is not substituted for the original requested statement.
portal.locator: Statement, External input and Source notes of thm-universal-brink-howlett-cover-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Length-additive elementary expressions

article.statement: For w∈Hom_BH(I,K), a standard expression is a finite composable product w=v_{a₁,I₁}⋯v_{a_m,I_m}, starting at I and ending at K, with ℓ(w)=Σ_iℓ(v_{a_i,I_i}). Its expression length is m. Existence and independence of the expression are subsequent assertions, not assumptions of this definition.
article.locator: Definition 4.9, printed p. 17.

portal.statement: The same definition at arbitrary rank. Each elementary factor requires its crossing component spherical. The empty expression represents an identity. The notation ℓ_BH(w) is introduced only after existence and invariance of factor count are established.

items.title: Standard expressions lift to geodesic paths

article.statement: A composable sequence of simple wall crossings is a geodesic path exactly when its product is a standard expression in BH. Every w∈Hom_BH(I,K) has a standard expression; its lift from (x,I) ends at (xw,K).
article.locator: Lemma 4.10 and equations (4.11)–(4.12), printed p. 18.

portal.statement: In finite rank, each standard expression has a unique geodesic lift from any prescribed chamber of its source type. For specified crossings, target-source compatibility is required. The empty expression corresponds to a one-chamber path. This geometric supplier alone does not establish arbitrary-rank existence.

items.title: Arbitrary-rank existence and parallel-class factor count

article.statement: No standalone article statement gives the parallel-class formula selected here. This is a portal helper supporting existence of standard expressions and invariance of their factor count; the parent article assertions are Lemma 4.10 and Corollary 4.13.
article.locator: Parent results: Lemma 4.10 and Corollary 4.13, printed p. 18. The formula m=|C(w)| is not attributed to an article lemma.

portal.statement: Every article morphism w has a standard expression. If an expression has m factors, then m=|C(w)|, using the opposite root-action arrow with the same label. Here C(w) is the finite set of real parallel classes contained in its positive inversion set. Its declared algebraic suppliers allow arbitrary rank.
portal.locator: Statement and Facts & Assumptions of lem-author-b19d43a8e520-bh-standard-factor-count; source references are empty, so article attribution is only through the stated parent results.

items.title: Elementary generation and invariance of standard length

article.statement: BH(J) is generated by v_{a,I} for associates I and a∉I with W_[I,a] finite. Any two standard expressions of the same morphism, with the same source, have the same number of factors.
article.locator: Corollary 4.13(1)–(2), printed p. 18.

portal.statement: The same generation and equal-factor-count assertions. Its current proof suppliers use the arbitrary-rank StandardFactorCount endpoint rather than relying on finite-rank chamber geometry.

items.title: Finite relative longest element inside an arbitrary system

article.statement: No standalone article lemma states this full construction and inversion-set formula. It is a portal helper for Lemma 4.15: finite Φ_{I∪{a,b}}\Φ_I allows construction inside the union of the components meeting {a,b}, without making I or the ambient system spherical.
article.locator: Parent result: Lemma 4.15 and equation (4.16), printed p. 19; related inverse characterization in Remark 4.17, printed p. 19.

portal.statement: At arbitrary rank, let a,b∉I be distinct, T=I∪{a,b}, and Φ_T\Φ_I finite. Let D be the union of components of T meeting {a,b}. Then W_D is finite. For r=w_Dw_{D∩I}, rΠ_I=Π_K for an associate K⊆T; q=r⁻¹ is an article morphism I→K and N(q)=Φ_T⁺\Φ_I⁺, where N(x)=Φ⁺∩xΦ⁻.

items.title: Minimal common prefix and its two standard expressions

article.statement: Let I be an associate of J and a,b∉I distinct, with |Φ_{I∪{a,b}}\Φ_I|<∞. There is an associate K and v_{a,b,I}:I→K left-divisible by v_{a,I},v_{b,I}, with exactly two standard expressions of equal factor count, starting respectively with these generators. Every BH morphism from I having both generators as length-additive left divisors has v_{a,b,I} as a left divisor. Thus this common multiple is minimal for left divisibility and standard-expression length.
article.locator: Lemma 4.15(1)–(2) and equation (4.16), printed p. 19.

portal.statement: The same theorem with its finite relative-root hypothesis retained. It chooses v_{a,b,I}=(w_Dw_{D∩I})⁻¹ using FiniteRelativeLongest. The declared supporting endpoints separately establish elementary prefixes, simultaneous-prefix minimality and exactly two standard words.

items.title: Atomic braid relations and contextual replacements

article.statement: Under Lemma 4.15's hypotheses, equating the two standard expressions of v_{a,b,I} in (4.16) is an atomic braid relation.
article.locator: Definition 4.18, Lemma 4.15 and equation (4.16), printed p. 19.

portal.statement: For distinct a,b outside an associate I with finite Φ_{I∪{a,b}}\Φ_I, the equality of the two supplied standard expressions defines the atomic braid relation. In the main theorem a move replaces either side inside a composable expression, retaining the surrounding factors.
portal.locator: Definition of def-atomic-braid-artin-tits-normalisers; contextual use in the Statement of thm-atomic-matsumoto-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Theorem 1.4 / 4.21: Atomic Matsumoto

article.statement: Let Γ be a Coxeter diagram, J⊆Γ₀, BH(J) its Brink–Howlett groupoid, and I,K associates of J. Any two standard expressions of w∈Hom_BH(I,K) are related by a sequence of atomic braid relations. Preserve the arbitrary-Coxeter-type scope: neither W, W_J, nor the enlarged parabolics W_{I∪{a}} are globally assumed finite. Standard expressions and atomic braid relations have exactly the meanings of Definitions 4.9 and 4.18.
article.locator: Theorem 1.4, printed p. 3; Theorem 4.21 and Remark 4.22, printed p. 20; Definitions 4.9 and 4.18, printed pp. 17 and 19.

portal.statement: For a Coxeter system without rank or type restriction, arbitrary J and associates I,K, any two finite length-additive elementary expressions of the same morphism w:I→K are connected by finitely many atomic braid relations. The finite relative-root condition needed for a two-generator relation is derived from the common prefixes; it is not added as a hypothesis of the main theorem.
portal.locator: Statement, Facts & Assumptions and External input of thm-atomic-matsumoto-artin-tits-normalisers.

BrinkHowlettGroupoid.type: ∀ {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S), CategoryTheory.Groupoid { I : Set S // ∃ w : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj w)) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J }
BrinkHowlettGroupoid.value:
by
  intro S W inst M cs J
  let roots : Set S → Set (Finsupp S Real) :=
    fun I => Set.image (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) I
  exact {
    Hom := fun I K => { w : W //
      Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs w) (roots K.val) = roots I.val }
    id := fun I => ⟨1, by simp⟩
    comp := fun {I K L} x y => ⟨x.val * y.val, by
      calc
        Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs (x.val * y.val)) (roots L.val)
            = Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val)
                (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs y.val) (roots L.val)) := by
                  simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, Set.image_image]
        _ = roots I.val := by rw [y.property, x.property]⟩
    id_comp := fun x => Subtype.ext (one_mul x.val)
    comp_id := fun x => Subtype.ext (mul_one x.val)
    assoc := fun x y z => Subtype.ext (mul_assoc x.val y.val z.val)
    inv := fun {I K} x => ⟨x.val⁻¹, by
      calc
        Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹) (roots I.val)
            = Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹)
                (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val) (roots K.val)) :=
                  congrArg (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹)) x.property.symm
        _ = roots K.val := by
          simp only [Set.image_image, Representation.inv_self_apply, Set.image_id']⟩
    inv_comp := fun x => Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel x.val)
    comp_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel x.val)
  }

SimpleWallCrossings.type: ∀ (S : Type _) (W : Type _) [Group W] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (I : Set S) (a : S) (_ha : a ∉ I), let D : Set S := {b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b}; Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs D) → W × Set S × (W → W × Set S)
SimpleWallCrossings.value:
fun S W _inst M cs I a _ha =>
  let D : Set S := {b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b}
  fun hD =>
    letI : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs D) := hD
    let longest : (L : Set S) → L ⊆ D → W := fun L hL =>
      letI : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L) :=
        Finite.of_injective
          (fun w : CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L => (⟨(w : W), (CoxeterSystem.parabolic_mono cs hL) w.property⟩ : CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs D))
          (fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs D => (z : W)) h))
      (Classical.choose (Finite.exists_max (fun w : CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L => CoxeterSystem.length cs (w : W)))).val
    let wD := longest D (fun _ h => h)
    let opposition : Equiv D D :=
      @Classical.epsilon (Equiv D D) ⟨Equiv.refl D⟩ (fun e => ∀ i : D, CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs wD (Finsupp.single (i : S) (1 : Real)) = -Finsupp.single (e i : S) (1 : Real))
    let aD : D := ⟨a, ⟨Set.mem_insert a I, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩⟩
    let v := longest (D \ {a}) Set.sdiff_subset * wD
    let K : Set S := Set.insert a I \ {(opposition aD : S)}
    (v, K, fun x => (x * v, K))

  let leftDiv : W → W → Prop := fun u v => CoxeterSystem.length cs v = CoxeterSystem.length cs u + CoxeterSystem.length cs (u⁻¹ * v)

AtomicBraidRelations.value:
fun {S W} _inst {M} cs J =>
  let Obj := { L : Set S // ∃ g : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g)) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J }
  let component : Set S → S → Set S := fun L a =>
    { b | b ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }
  let Atom := { p : Obj × S // p.2 ∉ p.1.val ∧ Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component p.1.val p.2)) }
  let crossing := fun e : Atom => SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
  let composable : List Atom → Set S → Set S → Prop := fun es L K =>
    List.foldr
      (fun e tail N => N = e.val.1.val ∧ tail (crossing e).2.1)
      (fun N => N = K) es L
  let parabolicRoots : Set S → Set (Finsupp S Real) := fun L =>
    { α | ∃ u : W, u ∈ CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L ∧ ∃ i : S, i ∈ L ∧
      CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs u (Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) = α }
  let braid : List Atom → List Atom → Prop := fun u v =>
    ∃ (L : Obj) (a b : S) (ha : a ∉ L.val) (hb : b ∉ L.val)
      (hab : a ≠ b)
      (hfin : Set.Finite (parabolicRoots (Set.insert a (Set.insert b L.val)) \ parabolicRoots L.val)),
      let h0 := TwoGeneratorMinimal cs J L a b ha hb hab hfin
      let hDa := Classical.choose h0
      let h1 := Classical.choose_spec h0
      let hDb := Classical.choose h1
      let h2 := Classical.choose_spec h1
      let K := Classical.choose h2
      let h3 := Classical.choose_spec h2
      let q := Classical.choose h3
      let h4 := Classical.choose_spec h3
      let ea := Classical.choose h4
      let eb := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec h4)
      (u = ea.val ∧ v = eb.val) ∨ (u = eb.val ∧ v = ea.val)
  fun es fs =>
    ∃ pre u v post : List Atom,
      braid u v ∧
      es = pre ++ u ++ post ∧
      fs = pre ++ v ++ post ∧
      ∃ L K : Obj, composable es L.val K.val ∧ composable fs L.val K.val

RelativeLocalFiniteness.type:
∀ {S : Type*} [Finite S] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S),
  letI : Fintype S := Fintype.ofFinite S
  let Θ := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace J
  letI : TopologicalSpace Θ := TopologicalSpace.induced
    (fun f : Θ => ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f.val)
    (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real))
  let data := RelativeCone M J
  let cone : Set Θ := data.1
  let coneInterior : Set Θ := data.2.1
  let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) := data.2.2.2.2.2
  let ball : Θ → Real → Set Θ := fun u r =>
    { v | Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i : S =>
        (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates v.val i -
         ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates u.val i) ^ 2) < r ^ 2 }
  (∀ u : Θ, u ∈ coneInterior → ∃ r : Real, 0 < r ∧
    ball u r ⊆ cone ∧
    Set.Finite { H : Submodule Real Θ | H ∈ arrangement ∧
      Set.Nonempty (ball u r ∩ (H : Set Θ)) }) ∧
  (∀ u : Θ, u ∈ coneInterior → ∃ U : Set Θ,
    IsOpen U ∧ u ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ coneInterior ∧
    Set.Finite { H : Submodule Real Θ | H ∈ arrangement ∧
      Set.Nonempty ((H : Set Θ) ∩ coneInterior) ∧
      Set.Nonempty (U ∩ (H : Set Θ)) })

ChamberLabelling.type:
∀ {S : Type*} [Finite S] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S),
  let Θ := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace J
  letI : TopologicalSpace Θ := TopologicalSpace.induced
    (fun f : Θ => ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f.val)
    (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real))
  let data := RelativeCone M J
  let coneInterior : Set Θ := data.2.1
  let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) := data.2.2.2.2.2
  let complement : Set Θ := { f | f ∈ coneInterior ∧
    ∀ H : Submodule Real Θ, H ∈ arrangement → f ∉ (H : Set Θ) }
  let chambers : Set (Set Θ) := { C | ∃ f : Θ,
    f ∈ complement ∧ C = connectedComponentIn complement f }
  let labels : Set (CoxeterMatrix.Group M × Set S) := { p |
    Set.image (fun u : CoxeterMatrix.Group M => u * p.1)
      (CoxeterSystem.parabolic (CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem M) J : Set (CoxeterMatrix.Group M)) =
    Set.image (fun u : CoxeterMatrix.Group M => p.1 * u)
      (CoxeterSystem.parabolic (CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem M) p.2 : Set (CoxeterMatrix.Group M)) ∧
    CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep (CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem M) p.2 p.1 }
  let face : Set S → Set (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S) := fun I =>
    { f | f ∈ ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace I ∧
      ∀ i : S, i ∉ I → 0 < ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f i }
  let labelRegion : (CoxeterMatrix.Group M × Set S) → Set Θ := fun p =>
    { f | ∃ g : ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S,
      g ∈ face p.2 ∧ ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualAction M p.1 g = f.val }
  Set.BijOn labelRegion labels chambers

AdjacentWallFormula.type:
∀ {S : Type*} [Finite S] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S),
  let W := CoxeterMatrix.Group M
  let cs := CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem M
  let Θ := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace J
  letI : TopologicalSpace Θ := TopologicalSpace.induced
    (fun f : Θ => ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f.val)
    (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real))
  let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) := (RelativeCone M J).2.2.2.2.2
  let label : W → Set S → Prop := fun x I =>
    Set.image (fun u : W => u * x) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J : Set W) =
      Set.image (fun u : W => x * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I : Set W) ∧
    CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs I x
  let face : Set S → Set (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S) := fun I =>
    { f | f ∈ ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace I ∧
      ∀ i : S, i ∉ I → 0 < ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f i }
  let region : W → Set S → Set Θ := fun x I =>
    { f | ∃ g : ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S,
      g ∈ face I ∧ ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualAction M x g = f.val }
  let affineDimension : Set Θ → Nat := fun A =>
    Module.finrank Real (AffineSubspace.direction (affineSpan Real A))
  let wall : Set Θ → Set Θ → Prop := fun C F =>
    Set.Nonempty F ∧ ∃ H : Submodule Real Θ, H ∈ arrangement ∧
      F = closure C ∩ (H : Set Θ) ∧ affineDimension F + 1 = affineDimension C
  let component : Set S → S → Set S := fun I a =>
    { b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }
  ∀ (x y : W) (I K : Set S), label x I → label y K →
    ∀ F : Set Θ, region x I ≠ region y K → wall (region x I) F → wall (region y K) F →
    ∃ (a a' : S) (ha : a ∉ I) (ha' : a' ∉ K),
      F = closure (region x (Set.insert a I)) ∧
      F = closure (region y (Set.insert a' K)) ∧
      (∀ c : S, c ∉ I → F = closure (region x (Set.insert c I)) → c = a) ∧
      (∀ c : S, c ∉ K → F = closure (region y (Set.insert c K)) → c = a') ∧
      Set.insert a I = Set.insert a' K ∧
      component I a = component K a' ∧
      CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component I a) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component K a') ∧
      ∃ (hD : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component I a)))
        (hD' : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component K a'))),
        let forward := SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I a ha hD
        let reverse := SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs K a' ha' hD'
        forward.2.2 x = (y, K) ∧ reverse.2.2 y = (x, I) ∧
        K = Set.insert a I \ {a'} ∧ I = Set.insert a' K \ {a} ∧
        forward.1 * reverse.1 = (1 : W) ∧ reverse.1 * forward.1 = (1 : W)

UniversalWallGroupoid.type: ∀ {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S), CategoryTheory.Groupoid { p : W × Set S // Set.image (fun u : W => u * p.1) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J : Set W) = Set.image (fun u : W => p.1 * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs p.2 : Set W) ∧ CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs p.2 p.1 }
UniversalWallGroupoid.value:
fun {S W} _inst {M} cs J => {
  Hom := fun A B => { w : W // w = A.val.1⁻¹ * B.val.1 }
  id := fun A => ⟨1, (inv_mul_cancel A.val.1).symm⟩
  comp := fun {A B C} f g => ⟨f.val * g.val, by
    rw [f.property, g.property]
    simp only [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left]⟩
  id_comp := fun f => Subtype.ext (one_mul f.val)
  comp_id := fun f => Subtype.ext (mul_one f.val)
  assoc := fun f g h => Subtype.ext (mul_assoc f.val g.val h.val)
  inv := fun {A B} f => ⟨f.val⁻¹, by
    rw [f.property, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv]⟩
  inv_comp := fun f => Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel f.val)
  comp_inv := fun f => Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel f.val)
}

  let W := CoxeterMatrix.Group M

  let Label := { p : W × Set S //

      Set.image (fun u : W => p.1 * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs p.2 : Set W) ∧
    CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs p.2 p.1 }
  let component : Set S → S → Set S := fun I a =>
    { b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }
  let Step := { e : Label × S // e.2 ∉ e.1.val.2 ∧
    Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component e.1.val.2 e.2)) }
  let crossing := fun e : Step =>
    SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val.2 e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
  let path : Label → Label → List Step → Prop := fun p q es =>
    List.foldr
      (fun e tail r => r = e.val.1.val ∧ tail ((crossing e).2.2 e.val.1.val.1))
      (fun r => r = q.val) es p.val
  ∀ (p q : Label) (es : List Step), path p q es →
    ((∀ fs : List Step, path p q fs → List.length es ≤ List.length fs) ↔
      CoxeterSystem.length cs (List.prod (List.map (fun e => (crossing e).1) es)) =
        List.sum (List.map (fun e => CoxeterSystem.length cs (crossing e).1) es))

NormaliserChamberAction.type:
∀ {S : Type*} [Finite S] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S),
  let W := CoxeterMatrix.Group M
  let cs := CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem M
  let Label := { p : W × Set S //
    Set.image (fun u : W => u * p.1) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J : Set W) =
      Set.image (fun u : W => p.1 * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs p.2 : Set W) ∧
    CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs p.2 p.1 }
  let Θ := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace J
  letI : TopologicalSpace Θ := TopologicalSpace.induced
    (fun f : Θ => ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f.val)
    (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real))
  let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) := (RelativeCone M J).2.2.2.2.2
  let face : Set S → Set (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S) := fun I =>
    { f | f ∈ ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace I ∧
      ∀ i : S, i ∉ I → 0 < ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f i }
  let region : Label → Set Θ := fun p =>
    { f | ∃ h : ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S,
      h ∈ face p.val.2 ∧ ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualAction M p.val.1 h = f.val }
  let affineDimension : Set Θ → Nat := fun C =>
    Module.finrank Real (AffineSubspace.direction (affineSpan Real C))
  let wall : Set Θ → Set Θ → Prop := fun C F =>
    Set.Nonempty F ∧ ∃ H : Submodule Real Θ, H ∈ arrangement ∧
      F = closure C ∩ (H : Set Θ) ∧ affineDimension F + 1 = affineDimension C
  let adjacent : Label → Label → Prop := fun p q =>
    region p ≠ region q ∧ ∃ F : Set Θ, wall (region p) F ∧ wall (region q) F
  let component : Set S → S → Set S := fun I a =>
    { b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }
  let Norm := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.CoxeterNormalizer M J
  let N := ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J
  let quotientMap : Norm → N := QuotientGroup.mk'
    ((ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf Norm)
  ∃ action : N →* Equiv.Perm Label,
    (∀ (g : Norm) (p : Label),
      let y := action (quotientMap g) p
      y.val.2 = p.val.2 ∧
      CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs p.val.2 y.val.1 ∧
      ∃ u : W, u ∈ CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs p.val.2 ∧
        y.val.1 = g.val * p.val.1 * u) ∧
    (∀ p q : Label, (∃ g : N, action g p = q) ↔ p.val.2 = q.val.2) ∧
    (∀ (g : N) (p : Label), action g p = p → g = 1) ∧
    (∀ (g : N) (p : Label),
      Set.image (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.quotientRepresentation M J g) (region p) =
        region (action g p)) ∧
    (∀ (g : N) (p q : Label), adjacent p q → adjacent (action g p) (action g q)) ∧
    (∀ (g : N) (p q : Label), adjacent p q →
      ∀ (a : S) (ha : a ∉ p.val.2)
        (hD : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component p.val.2 a))),
        (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs p.val.2 a ha hD).2.2 p.val.1 = q.val →
        (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs p.val.2 a ha hD).2.2 (action g p).val.1 =
          (action g q).val)

theorem coset_iff_conj {W : Type*} [Group W] (P Q : Subgroup W) (x : W) :
    (fun u => u * x) '' (P : Set W) = (fun u => x * u) '' (Q : Set W) ↔
    Q.map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom = P := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext z
    rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply]
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have ht : z * x ∈ (fun u => x * u) '' (Q : Set W) :=
        ⟨x⁻¹ * z * x, hz, by group⟩
      rw [← h] at ht
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := ht
      have : u = z := mul_right_cancel he
      simpa [this] using hu
    · intro hz
      have ht : z * x ∈ (fun u => u * x) '' (P : Set W) := ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      rw [h] at ht
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := ht
      have : x⁻¹ * z * x = u := by
        change x * u = z * x at he
        calc
          x⁻¹ * z * x = x⁻¹ * (z * x) := by group
          _ = x⁻¹ * (x * u) := by rw [← he]
          _ = u := by group
      simpa [this] using hu
  · intro h
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      change u ∈ P at hu
      rw [← h, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply] at hu
      exact ⟨x⁻¹ * u * x, hu, by group⟩
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨x * u * x⁻¹, ?_, by group⟩
      rw [← h]
      exact ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩

theorem conj_product {W : Type*} [Group W] (P : Subgroup W) (x y : W) :
    P.map (MulAut.conj (x * y)).toMonoidHom =
      (P.map (MulAut.conj y).toMonoidHom).map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom := by
  rw [Subgroup.map_map]
  congr 1
  ext z
  change (x*y)*z*(x*y)⁻¹ = x*(y*z*y⁻¹)*x⁻¹
  group

noncomputable def normalizedAction {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :
    Subgroup.normalizer (cs.parabolic J : Set W) →*
      Equiv.Perm {p : W × Set S //
        (fun u => u * p.1) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
        (fun u => p.1 * u) '' (cs.parabolic p.2 : Set W) ∧
        cs.IsMinimalCosetRep p.2 p.1} := by
  classical
  let Label := {p : W × Set S //
        (fun u => u * p.1) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
        (fun u => p.1 * u) '' (cs.parabolic p.2 : Set W) ∧
        cs.IsMinimalCosetRep p.2 p.1}
  let Norm := Subgroup.normalizer (cs.parabolic J : Set W)
  have htrans (g : Norm) (p : Label) :
      (cs.parabolic p.val.2).map (MulAut.conj (g.val * p.val.1)).toMonoidHom =
        cs.parabolic J := by
    rw [conj_product, (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mp p.property.1]
    exact Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff_map_conj_eq.mp g.property
  let act : Norm → Label → Label := fun g p =>
    ⟨(cs.minimalCosetRep p.val.2 (g.val * p.val.1), p.val.2),
      (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mpr
        (Chamber3.minimalCosetRep_transports_parabolic cs (htrans g p)),
      cs.isMinimalCosetRep_minimalCosetRep _ _⟩
  have act_spec (g : Norm) (p : Label) :
      ∃ u, u ∈ cs.parabolic p.val.2 ∧ (act g p).val.1 = g.val * p.val.1 * u := by
    refine ⟨(g.val * p.val.1)⁻¹ * (act g p).val.1,
      cs.inv_mul_minimalCosetRep_mem _ _, ?_⟩
    group
  have act_one (p : Label) : act 1 p = p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
    apply CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep.eq_of_inv_mul_mem cs
      (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_minimalCosetRep _ _) p.property.2
    obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := act_spec 1 p
    change (act 1 p).val.1⁻¹ * p.val.1 ∈ _
    rw [he]
    simpa only [Subgroup.coe_one, one_mul, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc,
      inv_mul_cancel_left, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one] using (cs.parabolic p.val.2).inv_mem hu
  have act_mul (g h : Norm) (p : Label) : act (g * h) p = act g (act h p) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
    apply CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep.eq_of_inv_mul_mem cs
      (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_minimalCosetRep _ _) (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_minimalCosetRep _ _)
    obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := act_spec (g*h) p
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hf⟩ := act_spec h p
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hk⟩ := act_spec g (act h p)
    change (act (g*h) p).val.1⁻¹ * (act g (act h p)).val.1 ∈ _
    rw [he, hk, hf]
    have hh : ((g*h).val*p.val.1*u)⁻¹ *
        (g.val*(h.val*p.val.1*v)*t) = u⁻¹*v*t := by
      change ((g.val*h.val)*p.val.1*u)⁻¹ * _ = _
      group
    rw [hh]
    exact (cs.parabolic p.val.2).mul_mem ((cs.parabolic p.val.2).mul_mem
      ((cs.parabolic p.val.2).inv_mem hu) hv) ht
  exact {
    toFun := fun g => {
      toFun := act g
      invFun := act g⁻¹
      left_inv := fun p => by rw [← act_mul, inv_mul_cancel, act_one]
      right_inv := fun p => by rw [← act_mul, mul_inv_cancel, act_one] }
    map_one' := by apply Equiv.ext; intro p; exact act_one p
    map_mul' := by intro g h; apply Equiv.ext; intro p; exact act_mul g h p }

import ArtinDeligne


noncomputable def RelativeCone : (∀ {S : Type*} [Finite S] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S), let Θ := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace J; let V := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Vector S; Set Θ × Set Θ × Set V × Set V × Set V × Set (Submodule Real Θ)) :=
(fun {S} _ M J =>
  let Θ := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace J
  let V := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Vector S
  letI : TopologicalSpace Θ :=
    TopologicalSpace.induced
      (fun f : Θ => ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f.val)
      (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real))
  let titsCone : Set (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S) :=
    { f | ∃ (w : CoxeterMatrix.Group M) (g : ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S),
        ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.IsDominant g ∧
        ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualAction M w g = f }
  let cone : Set Θ := { f | f.val ∈ titsCone }
  let relativeRoots : Set V := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.retainedRoots M J
  let positiveRelativeRoots : Set V := { r | r ∈ relativeRoots ∧ 0 < r }
  let negativeRelativeRoots : Set V := { r | r ∈ relativeRoots ∧ r < 0 }
  let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) :=
    Set.image (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.restrictedHyperplane J) positiveRelativeRoots
  (cone, interior cone, relativeRoots, positiveRelativeRoots, negativeRelativeRoots, arrangement))

open ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18 ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3

-- Local implementation for portal step 2.1:
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/item-lem-normaliser-chamber-action-artin-tits-normalisers
-- Parent: article Lemmas 3.23--3.24, printed p. 12. No standalone
-- article statement is attributed to the local have blocks below.
theorem wallTransport {S : Type*} [Finite S] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S) :
    let Θ := relativeSubspace J
    letI : TopologicalSpace Θ := TopologicalSpace.induced
      (fun f : Θ => dualCoordinates f.val)
      (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real))
    let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) := (RelativeCone M J).2.2.2.2.2
    let affineDimension : Set Θ → Nat := fun C =>
      Module.finrank Real (AffineSubspace.direction (affineSpan Real C))
    let wall : Set Θ → Set Θ → Prop := fun C F =>
      Set.Nonempty F ∧ ∃ H : Submodule Real Θ, H ∈ arrangement ∧
        F = closure C ∩ (H : Set Θ) ∧ affineDimension F + 1 = affineDimension C
    ∀ g : CoxeterNormalizer M J,
      let T := normalizerFlatEquiv M J g
      (∀ C F : Set Θ, wall C F → wall (T '' C) (T '' F)) ∧
      (∀ {Label : Type*} (region : Label → Set Θ) (σ : Label → Label),
        (∀ p, T '' region p = region (σ p)) →
        ∀ p q, (region p ≠ region q ∧ ∃ F, wall (region p) F ∧ wall (region q) F) →
          region (σ p) ≠ region (σ q) ∧
            ∃ F, wall (region (σ p)) F ∧ wall (region (σ q)) F) := by
  classical
  let Θ := relativeSubspace J
  have htop : TopologicalSpace.induced
      (fun f : Θ => dualCoordinates f.val)
      (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real)) =
      (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace Θ) := by
    exact induced_compose.symm
  dsimp only
  rw [htop]
  let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) := (RelativeCone M J).2.2.2.2.2
  let affineDimension : Set Θ → Nat := fun C =>
    Module.finrank Real (AffineSubspace.direction (affineSpan Real C))
  let wall : Set Θ → Set Θ → Prop := fun C F =>
    Set.Nonempty F ∧ ∃ H : Submodule Real Θ, H ∈ arrangement ∧
      F = closure C ∩ (H : Set Θ) ∧ affineDimension F + 1 = affineDimension C
  change ∀ g : CoxeterNormalizer M J, _
  intro g
  let T := normalizerFlatEquiv M J g
  -- Pairing gives transport of the actual restricted evaluation kernels.
  have hkernel (r : Vector S) :
      (restrictedHyperplane J r).map T.toLinearMap =
        restrictedHyperplane J (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation g.val r) := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      change (dualAction M g.val x.val)
        (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation g.val r) = 0
      rw [dualAction_pairing]
      exact hx
    · intro hy
      refine ⟨T.symm y, ?_, T.apply_symm_apply y⟩
      have hp := dualAction_pairing M g.val (T.symm y).val r
      change (T (T.symm y)).val
        (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation g.val r) = (T.symm y).val r at hp
      rw [T.apply_symm_apply] at hp
      exact hp.symm.trans hy
  have hnegKernel (r : Vector S) : restrictedHyperplane J (-r) =
      restrictedHyperplane J r := by
    ext f
    change f.val (-r) = 0 ↔ f.val r = 0
    rw [map_neg, neg_eq_zero]
  -- The endpoint arrangement uses positive retained roots. Transported roots
  -- need not be positive: use the root-sign dichotomy and equal opposite kernels.
  have harrangement (H : Submodule Real Θ) (hH : H ∈ arrangement) :
      H.map T.toLinearMap ∈ arrangement := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := hH
    have hs := geometricAction_mem_retainedRoots M J g hr.1
    have hsroot : M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation g.val r ∈
        M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots := hs.1
    rw [hkernel]
    rcases M.toCoxeterSystem.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hsroot with hpos | hneg
    · exact ⟨_, ⟨hs, hpos⟩, rfl⟩
    · have hns : -(M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation g.val r) ∈
          retainedRoots M J := by
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · exact M.toCoxeterSystem.neg_mem_geometricRoots_iff.mpr hsroot
        · obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hs.2
          exact ⟨f, by simpa only [map_neg, neg_ne_zero] using hf⟩
      exact ⟨_, ⟨hns, neg_pos.mpr hneg⟩, hnegKernel _⟩
  have hdimension (C : Set Θ) : affineDimension (T '' C) = affineDimension C := by
    change Module.finrank Real (affineSpan Real (T '' C)).direction = _
    let f : Θ →ᵃ[Real] Θ := (T.toLinearMap : Θ →ₗ[Real] Θ).toAffineMap
    change Module.finrank Real (affineSpan Real (f '' C)).direction = _
    rw [← AffineSubspace.map_span f, AffineSubspace.map_direction]
    exact T.toLinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq _
  -- General wall-image argument, kept local rather than a prerequisite item.
  have hwallImage (C F : Set Θ) (hF : wall C F) : wall (T '' C) (T '' F) := by
    obtain ⟨hne, H, hH, hFH, hdim⟩ := hF
    refine ⟨hne.image T, H.map T.toLinearMap, harrangement H hH, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change T '' F = closure (T '' C) ∩ T '' (H : Set Θ)
      rw [hFH, Set.image_inter T.injective, T.image_closure]
    · rw [hdimension, hdimension]
      exact hdim
  refine ⟨hwallImage, ?_⟩
  intro Label region σ hcov p q hpq
  obtain ⟨hne, F, hp, hq⟩ := hpq
  refine ⟨?_, T '' F, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro heq
    apply hne
    apply T.injective.image_injective
    rw [hcov, hcov, heq]
  · rw [← hcov]
    exact hwallImage _ _ hp
  · rw [← hcov]
    exact hwallImage _ _ hq

#print axioms wallTransport

-- Integration check for any normalizer-quotient label action with region covariance.
-- This wrapper is only a replay harness; no new prerequisite item is requested.
theorem quotientAdjacencyFromCovariance {S : Type*} [Finite S]
    (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S) :
    let Θ := relativeSubspace J
    letI : TopologicalSpace Θ := TopologicalSpace.induced
      (fun f : Θ => dualCoordinates f.val)
      (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real))
    let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) := (RelativeCone M J).2.2.2.2.2
    let affineDimension : Set Θ → Nat := fun C =>
      Module.finrank Real (AffineSubspace.direction (affineSpan Real C))
    let wall : Set Θ → Set Θ → Prop := fun C F =>
      Set.Nonempty F ∧ ∃ H : Submodule Real Θ, H ∈ arrangement ∧
        F = closure C ∩ (H : Set Θ) ∧ affineDimension F + 1 = affineDimension C
    ∀ {Label : Type*} (region : Label → Set Θ)
      (action : ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J →* Equiv.Perm Label),
      (∀ n p, quotientRepresentation M J n '' region p = region (action n p)) →
      ∀ n p q,
        (region p ≠ region q ∧ ∃ F, wall (region p) F ∧ wall (region q) F) →
        region (action n p) ≠ region (action n q) ∧
          ∃ F, wall (region (action n p)) F ∧ wall (region (action n q)) F := by
  dsimp only
  intro Label region action hcov n p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
    ((ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf (CoxeterNormalizer M J)) n
  have hrep : ⇑(quotientRepresentation M J
      (QuotientGroup.mk' ((ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf
        (CoxeterNormalizer M J)) g)) = ⇑(normalizerFlatEquiv M J g) := by
    funext x
    exact quotientRepresentation_mk M J g x
  apply (wallTransport M J g).2 region (action _) _ p q hpq
  intro r
  rw [← hrep]
  exact hcov _ r

#print axioms quotientAdjacencyFromCovariance
```

have nca_crossing_equivariance :
    ∀ (action : N →* Equiv.Perm Label),
      (∀ (g : Norm) (p : Label),
        let y := action (quotientMap g) p
        y.val.2 = p.val.2 ∧
        CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs p.val.2 y.val.1 ∧
        ∃ u : W, u ∈ CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs p.val.2 ∧
          y.val.1 = g.val * p.val.1 * u) →
      ∀ (adjacent : Label → Label → Prop) (n : N) (p q : Label), adjacent p q →
      ∀ (a : S) (ha : a ∉ p.val.2)
        (hD : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component p.val.2 a))),
        (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs p.val.2 a ha hD).2.2 p.val.1 = q.val →
        (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs p.val.2 a ha hD).2.2 (action n p).val.1 =
          (action n q).val := by
  intro action hrep adjacent n p q _ a ha hD hpq
  have coset_iff_conj (P Q : Subgroup W) (x : W) :
      (fun u => u * x) '' (P : Set W) = (fun u => x * u) '' (Q : Set W) ↔
      Q.map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom = P := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      ext z
      rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply]
      constructor
      · intro hz
        have ht : z * x ∈ (fun u => x * u) '' (Q : Set W) :=
          ⟨x⁻¹ * z * x, hz, by group⟩
        rw [← h] at ht
        obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := ht
        have : u = z := mul_right_cancel he
        simpa [this] using hu
      · intro hz
        have ht : z * x ∈ (fun u => u * x) '' (P : Set W) := ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
        rw [h] at ht
        obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := ht
        have : x⁻¹ * z * x = u := by
          change x * u = z * x at he
          calc
            x⁻¹ * z * x = x⁻¹ * (z * x) := by group
            _ = x⁻¹ * (x * u) := by rw [← he]
            _ = u := by group
        simpa [this] using hu
    · intro h
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
        change u ∈ P at hu
        rw [← h, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply] at hu
        exact ⟨x⁻¹ * u * x, hu, by group⟩
      · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨x * u * x⁻¹, ?_, by group⟩
        rw [← h]
        exact ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩

  have conj_product (P : Subgroup W) (x y : W) :
      P.map (MulAut.conj (x * y)).toMonoidHom =
        (P.map (MulAut.conj y).toMonoidHom).map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom := by
    rw [Subgroup.map_map]
    apply congrArg (fun f : W →* W => P.map f)
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro z
    change (x*y)*z*(x*y)⁻¹ = x*(y*z*y⁻¹)*x⁻¹
    group
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
    ((ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf Norm) n
  let c := SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs p.val.2 a ha hD
  have hq1 : q.val.1 = p.val.1 * c.1 := (congrArg Prod.fst hpq).symm
  have hq2 : q.val.2 = c.2.1 := (congrArg Prod.snd hpq).symm
  have hpconj := (coset_iff_conj (cs.parabolic J) (cs.parabolic p.val.2) p.val.1).mp p.property.1
  have hqconj := (coset_iff_conj (cs.parabolic J) (cs.parabolic q.val.2) q.val.1).mp q.property.1
  have hI : ∃ w : W, (cs.parabolic p.val.2).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom =
      cs.parabolic J := ⟨p.val.1, hpconj⟩
  obtain ⟨hK, f, hf⟩ := ElementaryWallMorphism cs J p.val.2 hI a ha hD
  have hroots : cs.geometricRepresentation c.1 ''
      ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) '' c.2.1) =
      (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) '' p.val.2 := by
    have h := f.property
    change cs.geometricRepresentation f.val ''
      ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) '' c.2.1) =
      (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) '' p.val.2 at h
    rwa [hf] at h
  have hconj : (cs.parabolic c.2.1).map (MulAut.conj c.1).toMonoidHom =
      cs.parabolic p.val.2 := by
    apply Subgroup.map_injective (f := (MulAut.conj p.val.1).toMonoidHom)
      (MulAut.conj p.val.1).injective
    rw [← conj_product, ← hq2, ← hq1, hqconj, hpconj]
  obtain ⟨_, hymin, u, hu, hy⟩ := hrep g p
  obtain ⟨hz2, hzmin, t, ht, hz⟩ := hrep g q
  have hmin : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep c.2.1
      ((action (quotientMap g) p).val.1 * c.1) := by
    apply cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mpr
    intro k hk
    have hr : cs.geometricRepresentation c.1 (Finsupp.single k (1 : Real)) ∈
        (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) '' p.val.2 :=
      hroots ▸ ⟨Finsupp.single k 1, ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi, heq⟩ := hr
    have hpos : 0 < cs.geometricRepresentation (action (quotientMap g) p).val.1
        (Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) :=
      (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff _ i).mpr
        (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mp hymin i hi)
    apply (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff _ k).mp
    simpa only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, ← heq] using hpos
  have hw : c.1⁻¹ * u * c.1 ∈ cs.parabolic c.2.1 := by
    rw [← hconj, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply] at hu
    exact hu
  have htK : t ∈ cs.parabolic c.2.1 := by simpa only [hq2] using ht
  have hdiff : ((action (quotientMap g) p).val.1 * c.1)⁻¹ *
      (action (quotientMap g) q).val.1 ∈ cs.parabolic c.2.1 := by
    have hmem := (cs.parabolic c.2.1).mul_mem ((cs.parabolic c.2.1).inv_mem hw) htK
    convert hmem using 1; rw [hy, hz, hq1]; group
  have hzminK : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep c.2.1 (action (quotientMap g) q).val.1 := by
    simpa only [hq2] using hzmin
  have heq : (action (quotientMap g) p).val.1 * c.1 =
      (action (quotientMap g) q).val.1 :=
    CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep.eq_of_inv_mul_mem cs hmin hzminK hdiff
  change ((action (quotientMap g) p).val.1 * c.1, c.2.1) = (action (quotientMap g) q).val
  exact Prod.ext heq (hz2.trans hq2).symm
```
